name: mujoco_scan_click_short
description: Short same-source factory-workshop map click through Gateway, actual Fast-LIO2, SCAN and the current ProductControl nav preset. World goal coordinates are independent evaluation input, not SLAM input.

claims: one ProductControl nav transaction selects actual Fast-LIO2 and SCAN
the Gateway map-click endpoint returns the task identity observed to REACHED
same-session physical motion reaches the independently specified world goal without entity collision
terminal driver zero acknowledgement, process cleanup and previous-Product rollback are verified
excluded_claims: physical mouse gesture through the operating system
global relocalization without an initial map pose
